method: Each quotation is normalised (Unicode compatibility forms, quotation marks, dashes, PDF line-break hyphenation, whitespace, case) and searched for in the normalised text of its card; fragments joined by an ellipsis must occur in order. Structural checks: one cell per card and question, passages for stated and partly cells, search terms for not-found cells, a reason for not-applicable cells, framework edition identifiers present in data/entities.json, and a list of evaluative words absent from notes and set-aside reasons.
